Read the given statements and conclusions carefully. Read the statement carefully and decide which of the two reasons explain(s) the event/observation/information given in the statement.Statement:The cricket team should have more than one wicketkeeper in a match.Reasons:I. If one of them gets injured, the other can do wicket keeping in place of him/her.II. More than one wicketkeeper will provide an extra trained fielder compared to others.
